basic_profile.bio: Passionate cryptocurrency enthusiast and proud owner of a Doberman Pinscher named Sparky. Living in Austin, Texas, I work as a freelance graphic designer with a keen interest in digital currencies and blockchain technology. I enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, usually between 10 PM and 1 AM CST. Currently single and focused on expanding my knowledge in crypto. I dislike misinformation and appreciate well-researched discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a self-taught background in cryptocurrency and blockchain, fueled by countless hours of online research and participation in forums and subreddits. My graphic design career started with a formal education in digital arts, with a growing interest in integrating tech innovations into my work.
